gsm.ctas 0.0.0.9000
  • Reference

Map a numeric findings domain with reference ranges to CTAS input

Input_Range.Rd

Like Input_Numeric(), but normalises each value by its own reference range via Prepare_Normalize(), so that tests measured on different scales become directly comparable. Intended for LB, but applies to any domain carrying low/high bounds.

Usage

Input_Range(
  dfDomain,
  strSubjectCol = "USUBJID",
  strTestCDCol = "LBTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "LBTEST",
  strValueCol = "LBSTRESN",
  strLowCol = "LBSTNRLO",
  strHighCol = "LBSTNRHI",
  strVisitCol = "VISIT",
  strVisitNumCol = "VISITNUM",
  strVisitPattern = NULL,
  strExcludePattern = "unsch",
  strCategory = "Labs",
  strPrefix = "LB_NORM"
)

Arguments

dfDomain

data.frame An SDTM domain.

strSubjectCol

character Subject identifier column.

strTestCDCol

character Short test-code column.

strTestCol

character Long test-name column. Falls back to strTestCDCol when NULL.

strValueCol

character Result column.

strLowCol

character Lower reference-bound column.

strHighCol

character Upper reference-bound column.

strVisitCol

character Name of the visit column.

strVisitNumCol

character Numeric visit-order column.

strVisitPattern

character Regular expression that a visit must match to be retained. NULL (default) keeps all visits.

strExcludePattern

character Regular expression whose matches are dropped. Matched case-insensitively. Default "unsch" removes unscheduled visits. NULL disables the exclusion.

strCategory

character Value written to parameter_category_1, used as the display grouping in downstream tools.

strPrefix

character Prefix for the generated parameter_id.

Value

list with elements data, parameters and untransformed.

Details

Rows with an invalid range (missing bound or non-positive width) yield NA and are dropped, since CTAS cannot use them.

Examples

Input_Range(data.frame(
  USUBJID = c("S1", "S1"),
  LBTESTCD = c("ALT", "ALT"),
  LBTEST = c("Alanine Aminotransferase", "Alanine Aminotransferase"),
  VISIT = c("WEEK 2", "WEEK 4"),
  VISITNUM = c(3, 4),
  LBSTRESN = c(20, 30),
  LBSTNRLO = c(10, 10),
  LBSTNRHI = c(40, 40)
))
#> $data
#>   subject_id parameter_id timepoint_1_name timepoint_2_name timepoint_rank
#> 1         S1  LB_NORM_ALT           WEEK 2             <NA>              1
#> 2         S1  LB_NORM_ALT           WEEK 4             <NA>              2
#>      result baseline
#> 1 0.3333333       NA
#> 2 0.6666667       NA
#> 
#> $parameters
#>   parameter_id                        parameter_name parameter_category_1
#> 1  LB_NORM_ALT Labs (norm): Alanine Aminotransferase                 Labs
#>   parameter_category_2 parameter_category_3
#> 1          LB_NORM_ALT     range_normalized
#> 
#> $untransformed
#>   subject_id parameter_category_2 timepoint_1_name original_value lower upper
#> 1         S1          LB_NORM_ALT           WEEK 2             20    10    40
#> 2         S1          LB_NORM_ALT           WEEK 4             30    10    40
#>   original_category
#> 1              <NA>
#> 2              <NA>
#>
